title: Paintball Insanity
description: First-person speedball. Clear five Gauntlet rounds of four, six, eight, ten and twelve opponents, each against a 200-second clock, with real paintball drop and spread. Payouts in Field Fees buy two more markers and unlock three harder tiers. Everything is paint: players are hit and out for the round, never harmed.
tagline: Five rounds. The field fills up.
controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim (click to lock), click to fire. Shift sprints, C crouches (sprint + C slides), Q/E lean, R reloads, F shoves. On touch: left thumb moves, drag to aim, FIRE / R / DUCK buttons.
